info.title: Glasgow Theatre API
info.description: Read-only listings for theatre, dance and performance in Glasgow. Free to use with attribution to Glasgow Theatre. Dates are Europe/London calendar dates; prices and times are a guide, so always confirm with the venue.

get.description: Filtered, paginated list. The static snapshot at /shows.json returns everything in one response.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Match runs that have not closed before this date.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Match runs that open on or before this date.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: A single day. Shorthand for from=date&to=date; cannot be combined with either.

parameters.name: venue
parameters.description: Venue id. Repeat the parameter or comma-separate values.

parameters.name: form
parameters.description: Art form, such as play, musical, dance or stand-up.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Any tag, including structural tags such as lunchtime.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive search over title, venue, description, producer, art form and tags.

parameters.name: free
parameters.description: Only shows whose published price is free.

parameters.name: payWhatYouLike
parameters.description: Only shows with a pay-what-you-like price.

parameters.name: hasPerformances
parameters.description: Only shows with at least one listed performance.

parameters.name: minPrice
parameters.description: Only shows whose known from-price is at least this amount.

parameters.name: maxPrice
parameters.description: Only shows whose known from-price is at most this amount.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Use txt for a tab-separated table suitable for shell scripts and C.

200.description: A page of shows, or a tab-separated table when format=txt.

200.description: A page of that venue's shows

id.description: Stable identifier, also used by the site's show page.

artForm.description: Exactly one art form, from the site's published vocabulary.

tags.description: Includes searchable structural tags such as lunchtime or scratch.

opens.description: A calendar date in Europe/London, with no time zone offset.

closes.description: A calendar date in Europe/London, with no time zone offset.

date.description: A calendar date in Europe/London, with no time zone offset.

time.description: 24-hour local time, or null when the venue has not confirmed one.

pricing.description: The venue's published price. `from` may be the cheapest seat still on sale, not the face value; `text` is the venue's own wording.

source.description: How the number was obtained, not whether it is live. `venue-feed` came from structured venue data; `published-text` was read from the venue's prose.

colour.description: The venue's house colour, adjusted to clear WCAG AA against ink.

ink.description: The legible text colour to use on colour.
